title: GEST-CT: Gesture-Controlled Use of CT Imaging Data to Improve Intraoperative Orientation in Head and Neck Surgery
summary: The aim of the study is to improve the surgeon’s orientation during surgery in the field of otorhinolaryngology (ENT) and to evaluate the benefits of the gesture-control system provided by AMERIA AG, Heidelberg. For this purpose, a 3D display from Sony will be combined with the AMERIA system for contactless gesture control to display the patient’s CT imaging data.

interventions.name: Use of the gesture-controlled display for intraoperative review of CT datasets
Control group: No intraoperative use of the gesture-controlled display

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Nasal sinus surgery planned, CT scan available, informed consent for surgery obtained
Exclusion criteria:
Below 18
